definitions.explanation: Words or actions used when meeting someone or on particular occasions.
A formal speech or remarks, especially at ceremonies.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}の{挨拶|あいさつ}をする。
{挨拶|あいさつ}もなしに{帰|かえ}った。
examples.english: They left without even saying goodbye.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}の{挨拶|あいさつ}があった。
examples.english: There was a speech by the president.

notes:
Functions as a noun and with する as a verb ({挨拶|あいさつ}する = to greet).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{挨拶|あいさつ}する (to greet)
・{挨拶|あいさつ}を{交|か}わす (exchange greetings)
・ご{挨拶|あいさつ} (greeting - polite)
・{挨拶|あいさつ}{回|まわ}り (making rounds to greet people)

COMMON GREETINGS:
・おはようございます (good morning)
・こんにちは (hello)
・こんばんは (good evening)
・さようなら (goodbye)
・いただきます / ごちそうさま (meal greetings)
